script.label: Fictional document check
script.description: A defensive example showing how an organisation can assess a document before relying on it.

stages.label: Assess the document
stages.description: The organisation records the document and determines whether independent verification is warranted.

activities.event: An authorised employee compares material claims with an authoritative record
observableTraces: the recorded receipt and the documented comparison result
activities.decisionPoint: decide whether corroboration or escalation is required

indicators.observation: A material claim conflicts with an authoritative record
corroboration: repeat the comparison through an independent channel
alternativeExplanations: a delayed update or administrative error
indicators.relevance: a corroborated mismatch supports proportionate escalation

measures.label: Request independent verification
measures.decisionMoment: when a material mismatch remains after the initial check
measures.intendedEffect: avoid relying on an uncorroborated document

safetyReview.notes: This fictional example contains only defensive review and escalation concepts.
